description: This file defines API route handlers for recipe-related operations in a FastAPI application, including listing recipes, getting recipe details, and searching recipes with filters.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance used to define recipe-related API endpoints.

methods.name: list_recipes(category_id: Optional[int] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list recipes, optionally filtered by category ID.

methods.name: get_recipe(recipe_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a recipe by its ID.

methods.name: search_recipes(q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search query"), ingredients: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Comma separated ingredients"), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to search recipes by name/description or ingredients.

ctags.name: list_recipes
ctags.pattern: /^def list_recipes(category_id: Optional[int] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/

ctags.name: search_recipes
ctags.signature: (q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search query"), ingredients: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Comma separated ingredients"), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
